what: Apple makes the iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch and AirPods, and runs a growing set of paid services on top of them: the App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple Pay and AppleCare.
customers: More than 2 billion active devices worldwide, mostly middle- and higher-income consumers, plus businesses and schools.
money: App Store, iCloud, subscriptions and the fee Google pays to be the default search engine; far higher margins than hardware
moat: A very strong brand, an ecosystem that keeps users (photos, messages and apps sync across devices) and in-house M- and A-series chips.
risks: Heavy dependence on iPhone upgrade cycles
Antitrust cases over the App Store and the Google search deal
Manufacturing concentrated in China; trade tensions
